title: Contracted katakana: N, H and M rows — write in kana
description: Use a Latin-letter spelling cue and base sign to distinguish small ャ/ュ/ョ from full-sized kana.

exercises.prompt: Type the contracted katakana nya using the ニ base sign and a small kana. Do not use a full-sized kana.
exercises.explanation: ニャ is the contracted nya spelling. Small ャ joins ニ; ニヤ uses full-sized ヤ. These written forms are not interchangeable.
